verses.1: Holy is Jehovah, for His goodness lasts forever.
verses.2: Let the servants of the LORD say, “They have been freed from the hand of evil people.”
verses.3: And from their lands, they were brought from the east and from the west, from the desert and from the mountains.
verses.4: They wandered along the coast in Bashimon, through a city that they couldn’t find.
verses.5: The hungry and thirsty in their hearts will be filled with sorrow.
verses.6: And they cried out to the LORD for help, from their difficult situations. May He save them!
verses.7: And they were led along the right path, towards the city where they would live.
verses.8: May Jehovah’s kindness and blessings be upon the children of men.
verses.9: For those who are filled with greed and hunger, they will be filled with evil.
verses.10: Those who dwell in darkness and obscurity, prisoners of poverty and misery.
verses.11: For the words of El were spoken, and his counsel was fulfilled.
verses.12: And their hearts became weak and they couldn’t resist.
verses.13: And they cried out to the LORD for help in their distresses, hoping that He would save them.
verses.14: Let them be freed from darkness, from their shadows, and from their misdeeds.
verses.15: May the LORD’s kindness and blessings be upon us, as well as His promises to us.
verses.16: For the doors of wickedness are broken open, and with iron chains they are locked.
verses.17: They wander along the paths of sin, and from their sins they will be punished.
verses.18: All food will disgust their souls, and they will end up in the gates of death.
verses.19: And they cried out to Jehovah for help, in their distress and suffering. May He save them!
verses.20: He will send His word, and they will be healed. He will remove their evils.
verses.21: May the LORD’s kindness and blessings be with the children of men.
verses.22: And they will worship the idols of Todesh, and they will recount his deeds in Rina.
verses.23: The workers of the sea come in ships, working in many waters.
verses.24: They saw the deeds of Jehovah and His miracles in their own eyes.
verses.25: And it was said, “A stormy wind stood up, and its waves rushed forward.”
verses.26: The heavens will rise; the mountains will descend. Their souls will be filled with evil, and they will be destroyed.
verses.27: They will prostrate and turn away, just like a shadow; all their wisdom will be destroyed.
verses.28: And they cried out to the LORD for help in their difficulties and from their hardships.
verses.29: He will cause a storm for the enemy, and he will measure their efforts.
verses.30: And they were glad, for they had been freed from their troubles. They were satisfied with what they desired.
verses.31: May the LORD’s kindness and blessings be upon us, and may they be with our children.
verses.32: And they praised him in the presence of the people, and the elders also glorified him.
verses.33: They will make rivers flow into the desert, and they will create springs of water for drinking.
verses.34: A land that produces fruit from the evil of its inhabitants.
verses.35: He will turn the desert into lakes, and the dry land into fertile fields for those who live by the sea.
verses.36: And there he placed the hungry ones, and he built a city for them to live in.
verses.37: And they sowed in the fields, and they planted them like trees. And they produced fruit in abundance.
verses.38: And He blessed them, and they multiplied greatly. And in their livestock, there was no limit to their numbers.
verses.39: And they were freed from that evil imprisonment.
verses.40: He poured it upon the generous ones, but it did not reach their hearts at all.
verses.41: And Ebon turned away from me, and he placed him among the sheep.
verses.42: May the righteous fear and rejoice, and may all creatures celebrate.
verses.43: May those who are wise and keep these rules be blessed, and may the mercies of Jehovah be increased upon them.
